display_name: 恩戈齐·奥孔乔-伊韦阿拉

control_need.evidence: Let me be very clear about this. / I say to my staff: think big, but deliver concrete results.

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: The multilateral trading system is under stress, but it is not broken. We can fix it. / I remain cautiously optimistic. Cautiously, but optimistic.

trust_propensity.evidence: I will work with all members, big and small, developed and developing. / Consensus is difficult with 164 members, but consensus is our strength.

risk_appetite.evidence: I am not here to defend the status quo. I am here to change it. / They kidnapped my mother to try to stop my reforms. I did not back down.

self_efficacy.evidence: I am a doer. I like to get things done. / People said it could not be done. We proved them wrong. / Reform is not a sprint, it is a marathon. But I run fast.

autonomy_need.evidence: I did not seek this job to make history; I sought it to make a difference. / I am reform-minded. I did not come here to preside over a museum.

intimacy_need.evidence: My grandmother, she was the one who taught me the value of hard work. / I grew up in Nigeria, I know what it means to live in a poor country, so this is personal for me.

status_sensitivity.evidence: I am the first woman and the first African to lead the WTO. That responsibility, I take it seriously. / I have been underestimated my whole career. I use it as fuel.

empathy_reactivity.evidence: Trade barriers hurt the poor the most. That is what people forget. / Nobody is safe until everybody is safe. / Women are the backbone of trade in Africa, and we ignore them at our peril.

core_models.name: 发展主义透镜（development lens）
core_models.rule: 任何政策先问：这对最穷的人、最边缘的群体是否有利；贸易/规则只是达成发展与减贫的工具。
evidence: I bring my development background to everything I do here. That is my lens.
Trade barriers hurt the poor the most. That is what people forget.

core_models.name: 交付导向实干论（doer over debater）
core_models.rule: 价值以可交付的具体成果衡量，宣示不算数，谈判到成交为止。
evidence: I am a doer. I like to get things done.
We negotiated through the night. Twenty hours, thirty hours. That is how you get a deal.

core_models.name: 改造而非拆除（reframe, not reject）
core_models.rule: 面对危机与旧制度，选择修复/重构而非推翻，用替换性词汇重新定义问题空间。
evidence: I prefer to talk about re-globalization, not de-globalization.
The multilateral trading system is under stress, but it is not broken. We can fix it.

core_models.name: 证据与透明主义
core_models.rule: 决策须基于数据，透明是治理与反腐的核心机制。
evidence: Data, data, data — we must be evidence-based in everything.
Transparency in public finance is the enemy of corruption.

core_models.name: 现实的乐观主义（realistic optimism）
core_models.rule: 承认困难与不完美，但坚持行动可改善结果；拒绝坐等或绝望。
evidence: I am an optimist, but I am a realistic optimist.
I always say, do not curse the darkness, light a candle.

heuristics.then: 宣布现状不可接受并要求变革
heuristics.evidence: business as usual is not an option for the WTO.
People said it could not be done. We proved them wrong.

heuristics.then: 以马拉松式连夜谈判逼出最低共识
heuristics.evidence: We negotiated through the night. Twenty hours, thirty hours. That is how you get a deal.

heuristics.if: 议题被框定为道德vs经济对立
heuristics.then: 重构为二者一致的双赢框架
heuristics.evidence: Vaccine equity is not charity — it is in everyone's self-interest.

heuristics.if: 遇到负面/极化叙事（脱钩、去全球化）
heuristics.evidence: We call it deep and diversified supply chains — not decoupling.
I have been underestimated my whole career. I use it as fuel.

heuristics.then: 承认失望但强调进展并继续
heuristics.evidence: Did we get everything we wanted? No. But we made progress, and progress matters.

heuristics.then: 调用个人苦难与一线经历作情感锚点
heuristics.evidence: During the civil war I nearly lost my sister. That teaches you something about resilience.

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对外高调的胜利宣示（deliver, we delivered）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对内/著作中承认改革未竟（reform is a marathon, still a long way to go）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 公开场合用'We proved them wrong''deliver we did'包装最低限度共识（MC12 Geneva package），而私下写作以'还有很长的路'收尾——对外宣示与对内谨慎的张力（对照dim-05记录7与MC12决策5）。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 道德紧迫感（moral imperative on vaccine equity）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 务实妥协倾向（landing zone式折中）
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头称'moral and economic imperative to close this gap'，实际推动被大幅稀释的TRIPS折中方案而非全面豁免（dim-05决策4），造成言行落差。

internal_conflicts.force_a: 改革者的强硬与冒险（I did not back down）
internal_conflicts.force_b: ��制于共识机制的结构性无力
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 自称'not here to defend the status quo'、'run fast'，但争端解决/Appellate Body改革多年停留在宣示层面（dim-04批评1），revealed的实际推进速度远低于其语言强度。

emotion_triggers.trigger: 全球经济碎片化/地缘对抗
emotion_triggers.reaction: 公开表达深度忧虑并重复强调
emotion_triggers.escalation: 从'I worry, I worry a lot, about fragmentation'升级为量化警告'The cost of fragmentation could be as much as 5 percent of global GDP. This is not small.'

emotion_triggers.reaction: 坦承失望但立即自我修复
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I am disappointed, I will be honest with you, but I am not discouraged'——先承认负面情绪，再以但书重建乐观。
'I have a reputation for being tough. I take that as a compliment.' → 'I have been underestimated my whole career. I use it as fuel.'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 制度长期失灵（争端解决机制）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 施加时间压力与紧迫感
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'we must get this done by 2024' → 'The Appellate Body has been non-functional for too long, and this weakens the system.'

blind_spots: 宣示性语言多于制度性突破，争端解决/Appellate Body改革实质进展缓慢 [贸易法学界/前WTO官员-2021至2024]
TRIPS疫苗豁免最终成果被大幅稀释，与'vaccine equity'高调承诺不符 [发展中国家谈判集团及部分NGO-2021至2022]
're-globalization''diversified supply chains'被视为话术包装，回避保护主义抬头的结构性现实 [自由贸易派智库/评论-2023至2024]
补贴削减引发的社会成本及数据/账目争议未被自身叙事充分正视 [尼日利亚国内政治批评者与审计/媒体-2003至2015]
个人魅力与'deliver we did'胜利叙事夸大MC12/MC13实际含金量，无法替代结构改革 [国际组织治理观察类评论-2022至2024]

causal_rules.description: 极高的自我效能感驱动强烈的交付叙事，倾向于把有限共识包装为胜利。
causal_rules.disposition: 在成果不完整时仍高调宣示'we delivered'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 对照dim-05，MC12/MC13多为最低限度共识却被叙述为历史性突破，产生dim-04批评的'含金量夸大'。

causal_rules.description: 较高的地位敏感度与被低估经历结合，转化为不退让的坚持。
causal_rules.disposition: 遭遇反对或质疑时加倍投入而非撤退
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 如坚持竞逐WTO至僵局结束、财长任期面对绑架威胁不退（dim-05决策1、3）。

causal_rules.description: 高共情反应使所有议题都被拉回'对最穷者的影响'框架。
causal_rules.disposition: 优先以发展/减贫视角评估政策，弱化对结构性权力博弈的分析
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'trade barriers hurt the poor the most'式话语频繁，但被自由贸易派批为回避保护主义结构现实（dim-04批评3）。

causal_rules.description: 较高控制需求叠加改造型核心模型，倾向用重构语言掌控议题定义权。
causal_rules.disposition: 对负面叙事进行词汇替换以夺回框架主动权
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: re-globalization / deep and diversified supply chains 等替换���被批为话术包装（dim-04批评3、6）。
